topic: The Wallis Product: Unveiling $\pi$ through Infinite Products

sections.title: Prerequisites: The Power of Sine Powers
lecture_lines: Consider the integral of sine to the power n.
As n increases, the area shrinks significantly.
The reduction formula links n to n-2.
animations: Create text: $I_n = \\int_0^{\\pi/2} \\sin^n(x) dx$. Color #FFFFFF, highlight line 1.
Fade in graph of sin(x) on [0, pi/2]. Color #FFCC00, highlight line 2.
Animate sin(x) shrinking to sin^n(x) as n increases. Color #FF6600, highlight line 3.

sections.title: The Wallis Ratio
lecture_lines: Examine the ratio of consecutive integral terms.
This ratio approaches one as n grows.
It provides the sandwich we need for pi.
animations: Display Wallis product ratio $R_n = I_{2n}/I_{2n+1}$. Color #FFFFFF, highlight line 1.
Visualize ratio approaching 1 as $n \\to \\infty$. Color #00FFCC, highlight line 2.
Highlight convergence point near limit. Color #FF6600, flash, highlight line 3.

sections.title: Deriving the Product Formula
lecture_lines: Substitute the reduction formula into the ratio.
This yields a pattern for pi over two.
We arrange these terms into an infinite product.
animations: Write recursive formula $I_n = \\frac{n-1}{n} I_{n-2}$. Color #FFFFFF, highlight line 1.
Chain multiple recursions into product sequence. Color #00FFCC, highlight line 2.
Display final product form for $I_n$. Color #FF6600, flash, highlight line 3.

sections.title: The Infinite Chain of $\pi$
lecture_lines: The resulting product formula defines pi.
Every term brings us closer to the value.
Infinite products reveal deep geometric truths.
animations: Show algebraic manipulation leading to $\\frac{\\pi}{2}$. Color #FFFFFF, highlight line 1.
Transform product into $\\frac{\\pi}{2} = \\prod_{n=1}^\\infty \\frac{(2n)^2}{(2n-1)(2n+1)}$. Color #00FFCC, highlight line 2.
Animate terms expanding into the infinite chain. Color #FF6600, flash, highlight line 3.

sections.title: Summary and Intuition
lecture_lines: Sine integrals bridge integers and constants.
Infinite products are powerful tools for calculation.
We successfully isolated pi through this method.
animations: Summarize key steps clearly on screen. Color #FFFFFF, highlight line 1.
Review the beauty of infinite product connection. Color #00FFCC, highlight line 2.
Final visualization of $\\pi$ emerging. Color #FF6600, flash, highlight line 3.
